designNotes: End-to-end use case: one record from lead to session; the ID never changes (BR-201).

cases.title: One person keeps one record from lead to first session

steps.action: Create a lead "QA Một Người" with a phone and note its ID
steps.expected: The lead is created with an ID

steps.action: Book an appointment and mark Show
steps.expected: The lead becomes a customer with the same ID

steps.action: Create and approve a contract, then book and confirm a session
steps.expected: The contract and the session belong to the customer with that same ID

testConditions: lead -> appointment -> Show -> contract -> session, same ID
cases.manualReason: Needs a record created earlier in the test carried through five steps and two people in sequence (contract approval).
